name: Proving Grounds: Trial of Weaponry
summary: A Muramite trial arena designed to test mastery of weapons, tactical execution, and martial discipline under Discord pressure.
description: The Trial of Weaponry is a brutal arena where Muramite overseers evaluate combatants based on their proficiency with weapons. The environment is filled with weapon racks, tactical lanes, and Discord pylons that destabilize improper technique. Dragorn captives are forced into weapon‑focused combat cycles, while Muramite soldiers prove their mastery of martial discipline. Discord constructs adapt to the weapon type used, creating a dynamic and punishing environment that rewards precision and punishes hesitation.
